name: Josephine Edenic
source:
Josephine Maria Edenic is the current Baroness Edenic.

Born to a rich Irish family, she married Baron Edenic in her early 20s and they presently have four sons between them.

Since a certain period she had begun to reside at London and raises racehorses, although she has not seen much notable success from the investment. She indulges in luxury with money from unclear sources while ignoring Oscar’s plea to economize.

Her illicit affairs with younger men are open secrets in high society.

Born in 1843.

[From digital artbook]
